0022600022.text: The Clippers (1-3, 0-2 on the road, on a three-game losing streak) are the 5th-game visitors at the Timberwolves (3-2, on a two-game skid) in West Group B of the Emirates NBA Cup, and they sit 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back. As of today, Los Angeles is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the last meeting 153-128 in Los Angeles on March 11, 2026, and no 2026-27 games have been played between them yet.
